name: Lonely Forest
style_block: Whimsical fantasy storybook illustration, expressive anime faces, painted surfaces, tactile bark and cloth, warm home within an endless dream.
lighting: Warm windows and lamps illuminate real surfaces. Indigo distance holds small violet and mint dream openings.

background.composition: Wide establishing view, clear landmark, three depth layers, open foreground for characters.
background.identity_policy: Keep the blue cottage, round window and broad living oak recognizable. Show one clear dream opening.
background.sample_prompt: MRQ, whimsical fantasy storybook environment, painted surfaces, tactile bark and wood. A huge ancient spreading oak shelters a small blue timber cottage with round window, slate roof and warm amber windows. Moss, garden paths and damp stones fill the open foreground. One violet and mint opening in the upper canopy holds a smaller oak and cottage. Blue-hour indigo distance, hearth honey, oak brown, moss green. Wide landscape, clear oak and cottage silhouettes, three layers of depth, environment only, unmarked surfaces, purely pictorial art.

avatar.composition: One complete full-body figure occupies about 70 percent of the frame. Leave room around ears, hands, tail and shoes.
avatar.identity_policy: Use the approved character reference for face, species, fur, hair, clothes and carried objects. This Rati sample tests the supplied mousefolk proposal.
avatar.sample_prompt: MRQ. Full-length portrait of a mature adult woman cottage host, thirty years old, tall adult figure with natural seven-head proportions, long dark wavy hair, rounded mouse ears, subtle mousefolk face, small tail. Blue knitted scarf, ochre linen dress, cream apron, sturdy brown shoes. She holds a plain ceramic teacup. Capable warm expression, small expressive eyes, softly painted cottage doorway, warm hearth light, indigo shade. Painterly fantasy anime with fine cloth texture. One complete figure with space around shoes and ears. No text, letters, signatures, logos, watermark or border.

purpose: Reusable art direction for future backgrounds and avatars; review edition.
